name: @cloudfuze/ai-governance-extension
description: MV3 browser extension for AI service DLP. Vendor deps are pinned to UMD-compatible versions so they load as classic content scripts. `type: module` is for NODE only (lib/*.js is ESM, imported by the MV3 module service worker and by the tests) — Chrome ignores this file, and content scripts are still classic scripts loaded via the manifest.
